title: Label printer firmware rejects fast resends
body:
# Label printer firmware rejects fast resends

The printer firmware rejects any job that is re-sent within 90 seconds of a failed print, and reports a paper jam that is not real. A retry has to wait at least 90 seconds after the failure.

title: Label queue retries use a flat delay
body:
# Label queue retries use a flat delay

A failed label print is retried after 45 seconds, up to 4 times, with the same delay each time. A job that fails the fourth attempt is moved to the manual tray list.
